title: We’re Calling an Intervention: Exploring Fundamental Hurdles in Adapting Language Models to Nonstandard Text

bias_targets.methodology: Applying synthetic linguistic interventions (character-level changes, subword boundary manipulations, morphological variations, and lexical variations) to standard English text to simulate nonstandard language varieties, and measuring the masked language modeling (mask-filling) accuracy of BERT and mBERT before and after fine-tuning.
